name: orpheus-rag
description: Read-only private knowledge retrieval from the user's Orpheus RAGFlow instance.

interface.shortDescription: Search the private Orpheus knowledge base on demand.
interface.longDescription: A read-only plugin for explicitly requested retrieval from the user's private RAGFlow knowledge base. It lists available datasets and retrieves source chunks without exposing database administration or write operations.
defaultPrompt: Search my Orpheus knowledge base for this question.
Verify this against my private RAG documents and cite the source chunks.
